scope: Beam review contract for prospective shared Chronology integration; no implementation approval

agreed_preconditions.chronology: Real ISO/Buddhist production factories; UTC or fixed +07:00 offset; explicit null means default ISO for constructors/retain. JVM default timezone pinned UTC and production UTCProvider selected explicitly. Named-zone/resource coverage is outside this candidate.
agreed_preconditions.method_receiver: Start with default Partial then seed hourOfDay=10, or year=2024 for getField. Assert receiver values and chronology before activating target tracing.
agreed_preconditions.getField: Protected target called from package-local probe on a real final Partial. Valid index 0; separate invalid index 1 boundary. Supplied Buddhist chronology must determine the field independently of receiver ISO chronology.
agreed_preconditions.public_array_constructor: Sorted year/month/day with independently specified leap-day values; separate invalid February 30 and year/dayOfMonth/era ordering rejection.
agreed_preconditions.internal_constructor: Package-private Chronology-first constructor skips validation and stores arrays directly. Use independently validated UTC fields/values; no claim of input cloning, arbitrary value validation or zone normalization for this signature.

agreed_assertions: Exact field types, named and indexed values, UTC normalization and concrete chronology class
Public array constructor protects stored values/types from input and getter-array mutation
Invalid hour/date/order rejected via exact constructor; bad index via exact getField
Buddhist year at epoch is 2513; exact supplied production year field and unchanged ISO receiver
Chronology-retain preserves hour 10, original receiver, new-object vs same-normalized-chronology identity, and null-to-ISO behavior
required_integration_checks: Same exact declaration/receiver identities in all four approaches
Package-local or equally exact protected/internal invocation on production Partial
UTC default/UTCProvider and only UTC/fixed +07:00 chronology factories
Internal constructor uses already-validated UTC arrays; no clone/normalization/validation claim
Default method receivers seeded before target tracing; setup/projection failures are fixture_error
Preserve exact exception, Buddhist field/epoch-year, receiver state, array mutation and identity assertions
Seal and test shared runtime/recipes, fixed repeatability, buggy and exact target-entry evidence before selection
required_future_evidence: fixed twice / buggy / exact target-entry checks
all four consumer bindings on final 20-bug preparation
beam-pc1 one-CPU host bindings for final runner
